name: Planning for next summer semester, cybersecurity track
description: First persona to exercise the next-semester 'probably not offered' flag (step 4, wired 2026-10-20). Never excludes a module -- only flags it, since the handbook's own cycle data is a stated pattern, not a guarantee. 'Advanced Network Security' (winter) and 'Communication Systems Engineering' (winter) must flag true when the student says next semester is summer; 'IT-Security 1/2' (both) must stay false; 'Industrial Network/Data Security' (irregular) must also stay false -- an irregular cycle is genuinely unknown, not a mismatch, and must never be guessed into a flag.
